channel.title: Bookish | OuqCreations
channel.description: Bookish: cute, funny character stickers, shirts, mugs and gifts by OuqCreations.

item.title: Bookish Orange Cat Annotating My Feelings Again
item.description: An orange cat lounges on its tummy with a book full of colourful sticky tabs, working through every emotion one annotation at a time. A funny gift for readers, book club friends and cat lovers, on stickers, tote bags and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Sleepy Axolotl Reading Just One More Chapter
item.description: A sleepy axolotl lies on its tummy with an open book, promising just one more chapter long past bedtime. Perfect for bookworms, librarians and late night readers, it makes a funny gift. Available on stickers, mugs and tote bags. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Cute Reading Bat Up All Night With a Book
item.description: A cute bat hangs upside down with an open book, admitting it stayed up all night reading again. Perfect for bookworms and night owl readers, it makes a funny gift for anyone who can't stop at one more chapter. Available on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Bookish Ghost Haunting the Library After Hours
item.description: A sweet little ghost hugs its favourite book while haunting the library after hours. A cozy, spooky gift for bookworms, librarians and anyone who reads late into the night. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
